comment: Embedding models the app may download for search by meaning, only after the user agrees (SPEC §16.3, §17.1, DEC-12; STATE.md F7.1; ADR-0035). The trust anchor (allowed repositories) is in crates/vv-engine/src/models.rs. sha256/size are pinned from the Hugging Face file listing at `revision` (scripts/model-pins.mjs). The model's authors publish no second hash, so the pinned SHA-256 is the only check.
